title: Lagos Anime Watch Night
description: Outdoor screening of fan-voted episodes, cosplay walk and a trivia round between screenings.

title: Studio Spotlight Meetup
description: Fans present short talks on their favourite animation studios, followed by a sketch jam.

title: Summer Cosplay Picnic
description: Photo walks, prop swaps and a lot of wigs in the heat. Thanks to everyone who came.

title: Retro Arcade Weekend
location: Ikeja City Mall Event Space, Lagos
description: Classic consoles, fighting game brackets and a high-score board that resets every hour.

title: Speedrun Marathon Stream Party
description: Watch local runners attempt personal bests live, with donations going to a children's coding charity.

title: Indie Dev Showcase
description: Local developers let fans play early builds and give feedback face to face.

title: Sci-Fi Double Feature Night
description: Two classic sci-fi films back to back with a costume contest in between.

title: Short Film Fan Awards
description: Fan-made short films compete for audience votes. Submissions open until December.

title: Soundtrack Live Session
description: A small orchestra played themes from famous film scores. It sold out in a day.

title: Finale Watch Party
description: Big screen, snacks and a room full of people who have been theorising all season.

title: Horror Series Marathon
description: An overnight synced watch of spooky episodes with a live chat room.

title: Showrunner Q&A (fan-hosted)
description: Film students discussed how their favourite shows are written and planned.

title: Random Play Dance Lagos
description: Songs play in random order and anyone who knows the choreo jumps in. Bring water.

title: Comeback Listening Party
description: First listen of new releases together, plus a lightstick swap table.

title: Dance Cover Competition
description: Twelve crews competed. Congratulations to the winning team for their perfect synchro.

title: Free Comic Swap Day
description: Bring a comic, take a comic. Local artists will be sketching at the tables.

title: Draw Your Hero Workshop
description: A beginner-friendly session on inking and panel layout with a local illustrator.

title: African Comics Showcase
description: Creators from across the continent showed their work and talked about publishing.

title: Manga Reading Club
description: This month's pick is the first volume of a classic seinen series. Snacks provided.

title: One-Shot Contest Results
description: Fan-made one-shot manga, read and judged live on stream.

title: Panel Art Exhibition
description: Fan tributes to famous manga pages, hand-drawn and painted.
